title: Extraordinary Extras
description: This mod adds new biomes and minerals and new materials
body:
Does your minecraft world feel like it is missing a green stone type, a grey (and green) wood type? 

are other mods too big for you?

Well then this is the mod for you!

it adds a new stone type named **limestone** that has its stair and wall varients and it also has a Polished varient with its own varients **_WOW_**

it also adds The heavily ambient **_grey wood forest_**

**_There are also 2 more biomes that ill let you find_**
